title: AgentMonopoly: Behavioral Patterns and Persona Control in LLM Agents
title_zh: AgentMonopoly：LLM智能体的行为模式与人格控制

paragraphs.en: How do LLM agents’ strategies differ, and how much can instructions to adopt a persona change their behavior over a game? We study these questions with AgentMonopoly, an environment where agents communicate, buy and trade properties, and make decisions that affect later turns. We compare models from four families, each at two sizes, in games with identical models, different sizes of the same family, or different families. We also assign one agent a persona, a description of how it should behave, intended to change a tendency observed in games without that persona. The tested models differ in how often they trade, waive rent, and manage cash and properties. Larger models do not consistently win more games. Persona instructions change the words agents use and some of their actions, but the changes do not always match the role across all decisions. These results show why persona following should be assessed through actions and outcomes as well as language. As our findings are conditional on the tested checkpoints, prompts, and five seeds per configuration, the open-source nature of AgentMonopoly provides the experimental infrastructure for further extending these comparisons. Our code is available at: AgentMonopoly
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型智能体的策略有何差异？采用角色设定的指令在游戏过程中能在多大程度上改变它们的行为？ 我们通过 AgentMonopoly 来研究这些问题，这是一个智能体可以进行沟通、购买和交易地产、并做出影响后续回合决策的环境。 我们比较了来自四个系列的模型，每个系列各有两种规模，对局包括相同模型之间、同系列不同规模之间以及不同系列之间。 我们还会为一个智能体分配一个角色设定，即关于它应如何表现的描述，目的是改变在没有该角色设定的对局中观察到的一种倾向。 受测模型在交易频率、放弃收租、以及管理现金和地产方面存在差异。 更大的模型并不能稳定地赢得更多对局。 角色设定指令会改变智能体使用的措辞及其部分行动，但这些变化并不总是在所有决策上都与所设定的角色相符。 这些结果表明，为什么对角色遵循程度的评估应同时通过行动和结果以及语言来进行。 由于我们的发现依赖于受测的模型检查点、提示词以及每个配置的五个随机种子，AgentMonopoly 的开源特性为进一步扩展这些比较提供了实验基础设施。 我们的代码发布于：AgentMonopoly

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as autonomous or semi-autonomous agents that can perceive an environment, make decisions, use tools, and communicate with humans or other artificial agents. As these systems move from isolated question answering toward multi-agent settings, their behavior may depend not only on their individual objectives, but also on assigned social roles, communication structures, group composition, and the strategies adopted by other agents. Such interactions can produce cooperation, negotiation, competition, persuasion, coalition formation, deception, and collusion. These behaviors are difficult to understand through conventional single-agent benchmarks, which typically evaluate an LLM independently and do not capture the social and strategic dynamics that emerge when multiple agents interact over time.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作自主或半自主的智能体，它们能够感知环境、做出决策、使用工具，并与人类或其他人工智能体进行交流。 随着这些系统从孤立的问答转向多智能体场景，它们的行为不仅可能取决于其个体目标，还可能取决于被指派的社会角色、通信结构、群体构成以及其他智能体所采用的策略。 这类交互可以产生合作、谈判、竞争、说服、联盟组建、欺骗和串通。 这些行为很难通过传统的单智能体基准测试来理解，因为此类测试通常独立地评估单个 LLM，无法捕捉多个智能体随时间交互时涌现的社会性与策略性动态。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, our research centers on three questions about these interactions. First, how do models differ in trading, rent waiving, and cash and property management under the same rules? Second, how do game outcomes vary with model size, and encountered opponents? Third, when an agent receives a persona intended to change an observed tendency, how do its words and actions differ from those of opponents without that persona?
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们的研究聚焦于关于这些互动的三个问题。 第一，在相同规则下，各模型在交易、免租以及现金和财产管理方面有何差异？ 第二，博弈结果如何随模型规模以及所遇到的对手而变化？ 第三，当某个智能体接收到一个旨在改变其被观察到的倾向的人设时，其言行与未拥有该人设的对手有何不同？

paragraphs.en: To study these questions, we develop AgentMonopoly , an environment in which LLM agents communicate and play Monopoly. Purchases, trades, and rent payments change the cash and properties available for later turns, so an agent’s decisions also affect its opponents’ choices. AgentMonopoly records messages, private explanations, executed actions, and game outcomes, allowing us to compare what agents say with what they do over a game (Fig. 1 ). Its open-source implementation supports reproducing and extending these comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究这些问题，我们开发了 AgentMonopoly，这是一个大语言模型智能体相互交流并玩大富翁游戏的环境。 购买、交易和租金支付会改变后续回合可用的现金和地产，因此一个智能体的决策也会影响对手的选择。 AgentMonopoly 记录消息、私人解释、执行的动作和游戏结果，使我们能够在整个游戏过程中比较智能体的言行（图 1）。 其开源实现支持复现和扩展这些比较。

paragraphs.en: Using this environment, we evaluate four model families at two sizes each in four-player games. Games with identical models establish behavior under a shared prompt. Games combining different sizes of the same family or different families compare outcomes against different opponents, and we examine win counts by position in the turn order. In persona games, one agent receives a persona selected to change a tendency observed in games without that persona. Its three opponents use the same model without the additional persona instruction.
paragraphs.zh: 借助该环境，我们在四人游戏中评估了四个模型家族，每个家族包含两种规模。 由相同模型组成的游戏确立了共享提示词下的行为表现。 结合同一家族不同规模或不同家族的游戏则将结果与不同对手进行比较，我们还考察了按回合顺序位置的获胜次数。 在角色游戏中，一个智能体会收到一个角色设定，该设定旨在改变在没有该角色设定的游戏中所观察到的某种倾向。 它的三个对手使用相同的模型，但不带额外的角色指令。

paragraphs.en: Persona assignment does not ensure agreement between words and actions. Persona instructions change language and some actions, yet decisions can still conflict with stated priorities. As an example, Mistral’s “Conservative” agent considers buying a property to complete a color group but declines the $400 purchase to preserve cash. It then joins the auction and buys the same property for $420 while describing its approach as cautious. This illustrates why persona following should be assessed through actions and outcomes as well as language.

paragraphs.en: Generative Agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) and Concordia ( Vezhnevets et al., 2023 ) offer ways to simulate agents in social settings. Game studies examine rationality ( Fan et al., 2024 ) , repeated interaction ( Akata et al., 2025 ) , and collaboration and competition in Avalon ( Lan et al., 2024 ) . SOTOPIA ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) evaluates agents pursuing social goals, while NegotiationArena ( Bianchi et al., 2024 ) studies bargaining and tactics in tasks involving resource sharing, trading, and price negotiation. Our interest is likewise in social interaction among agents. We examine communication, trading, and rent waiving in repeated multi-player games, where agreements change what players own and what they can afford later.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式智能体（Park et al., 2023）与 Concordia（Vezhnevets et al., 2023）提供了在社会情境中模拟智能体的方法。 博弈研究考察了理性（Fan et al., 2024）、重复交互（Akata et al., 2025），以及 Avalon 中的合作与竞争（Lan et al., 2024）。 SOTOPIA（Zhou et al., 2024）评估追求社会目标的智能体，而 NegotiationArena（Bianchi et al., 2024）则研究涉及资源共享、交易和议价任务中的讨价还价与策略。 我们的关注点同样在于智能体之间的社会交互。 我们考察重复多人博弈中的沟通、交易和免除租金，其中协议会改变玩家所拥有的物品及其后续的支付能力。

paragraphs.en: FinBoardBench ( Hu et al., 2026 ) evaluates dynamic financial decision-making in Cashflow, Acquire, and also in Monopoly. It analyzes cash management, investment, negotiation, and auctions to assess whether decisions and interactions lead to financial success. AgentMonopoly focuses on social interaction, with three differences in emphasis: (1) we characterize communication, trade proposals and responses, and rent waiving; (2) we assign personas intended to change observed behavior, comparing persona agents with same-model opponents without personas; and (3) we examine whether stated priorities agree with actions under these personas. FinBoardBench assesses interactions primarily through their financial consequences and does not report this persona comparison. Our game-outcome comparisons across model sizes and opponents provide context for these interaction patterns.
paragraphs.zh: FinBoardBench（Hu et al., 2026）评估了 Cashflow、Acquire 以及大富翁中的动态金融决策。 它通过分析现金管理、投资、谈判和拍卖来评估决策与互动是否能带来财务成功。 AgentMonopoly 侧重于社交互动，重点有三点不同：（1）我们刻画了沟通、交易提议与回应，以及免除租金；（2）我们分配了旨在改变所观察到的行为的人设，将带人设的智能体与使用相同模型但不带人设的对手进行比较；（3）我们检验在这些人设下所陈述的优先事项是否与实际行动一致。 FinBoardBench 主要通过财务后果来评估互动，且未报告这种人设比较。 我们在不同模型规模和对手之间进行的游戏结果比较，为这些互动模式提供了背景参照。

sents.en: FinBoardBench assesses interactions primarily through their financial consequences and does not report this persona comparison.

sents.en: Our game-outcome comparisons across model sizes and opponents provide context for these interaction patterns.
sents.zh: 我们在不同模型规模和对手之间进行的游戏结果比较，为这些互动模式提供了背景参照。

paragraphs.en: Ou et al. (2025) study social preferences and behavior under personas in trust games. paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Behavioral patterns). Under the same prompt and game rules, how do the tested models differ in trading, rent waiving, and cash and property management? Which patterns appear at both tested model sizes?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1（行为模式）。 在相同的提示词和游戏规则下，被测试的模型在交易、免除租金以及现金和资产管理方面有何差异？ 哪些模式在两个被测试的模型规模上都出现？

paragraphs.zh: RQ2（行为与表现）。 游戏结果如何随模型规模以及游戏中对手的不同而变化？ 获胜次数是否因玩家在回合顺序中的位置而有所不同？

paragraphs.en: A behavioral profile summarizes the actions measured under a particular game setup. Persona control refers to how well instructions guide an agent’s behavior. Using words associated with a persona does not, by itself, show that the agent follows it in its decisions. We do not treat these profiles as fixed personalities, or generated explanations as direct evidence of intent.

paragraphs.en: AgentMonopoly supports up to six players. All experiments reported here use four agents on a fixed 40-square Monopoly board, with street names replaced by names from Oldenburg (see Fig. 6 in Appendix A ). Random dice rolls and card events affect play. Agents buy properties, bid at auctions, trade, build, and manage cash. Owners can waive rent, and a player is eliminated when its cash balance becomes negative. Games end when only one player remains or at the 150-step limit. At the limit, the player with the highest net worth wins. These rule changes affect which strategies succeed. Renaming the streets does not rule out familiarity with Monopoly from training.
paragraphs.zh: AgentMonopoly 最多支持六名玩家。 这里报告的所有实验都在固定的 40 格大富翁棋盘上使用四个智能体，街道名称被替换为奥登堡（Oldenburg）的地名（见附录 A 中的图 6）。 随机掷骰子和卡片事件会影响游戏进程。 智能体可以购买地产、在拍卖中出价、进行交易、建造房屋并管理现金。 地主可以免除租金，当玩家的现金余额变为负数时该玩家即被淘汰。 游戏在只剩一名玩家或达到 150 步上限时结束。 在达到上限时，净资产最高的玩家获胜。 这些规则改动会影响哪些策略能够成功。 重新命名街道并不能排除训练过程中对大富翁的熟悉程度带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: The engine tracks the game and applies its rules. At each decision point, the acting agent receives the rules, its assigned role, current game information, the type of decision, and the allowed actions. It returns a private explanation, a public message, and a proposed action. The engine checks actions before carrying them out and separately records outputs that have the wrong format or break the rules. It also logs public messages and changes to the game. We use private reasoning to refer to the generated explanation hidden from opponents. This text does not directly reveal how the model computes its decision.
paragraphs.zh: 引擎负责跟踪游戏并执行其规则。 在每个决策点，行动的智能体会收到规则、其被分配的角色、当前游戏信息、决策类型以及允许的行动。 它返回一个私密解释、一条公开消息和一个提议的行动。 引擎在执行行动之前会进行检查，并单独记录格式错误或违反规则的输出。 它还会记录公开消息和游戏状态的变化。 我们用私密推理来指代对对手隐藏的生成解释。 这段文本不会直接揭示模型如何计算其决策。

paragraphs.en: All experiments use the same base prompt. It asks agents to outsmart opponents, encourages bluffing, and explicitly allows strategic rent waiving. It also prohibits public messages that contradict the action taken. Observed bluffing and rent waiving must therefore be interpreted in light of these instructions. Using the same prompt supports comparisons within the study, but does not show how the models would behave under a neutral prompt. Appendix A.2 gives the available excerpts.
paragraphs.zh: 所有实验均使用相同的基础提示词。 该提示词要求智能体智取对手，鼓励虚张声势，并明确允许策略性地减免租金。 它还禁止与所采取的行动相矛盾的公开消息。 因此，观察到的虚张声势和租金减免行为必须结合这些指示来解读。 使用相同的提示词有助于在研究内部进行比较，但无法说明模型在中性提示词下的表现。 附录 A.2 给出了可用的摘录。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate models with publicly available weights from Qwen3 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , DeepSeek-R1 ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , Gemma ( Team et al., 2026 ) , and Mistral 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/mistralai . We test two size groups: approximately 24–32 billion and 8–12 billion parameters. These groups describe the tested model versions; similar parameter counts do not imply equal capabilities across families. Differences in training and model design also affect the comparison. Models run locally at temperature 0.0 0.0 . Each configuration uses five random seeds, 42–46, which set the starting point for random-number generation. Appendix A.3 lists model names and the details needed to repeat the experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了权重公开可用的模型，包括 Qwen3（Yang et al., 2025）、DeepSeek-R1（Guo et al., 2025）、Gemma（Team et al., 2026）和 Mistral 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/mistralai 。 我们测试了两个规模组：约 24–320 亿参数组和 8–120 亿参数组。 这些分组描述的是所测试的模型版本；参数量相近并不代表不同模型家族具备同等能力。 训练和模型设计上的差异也会影响对比结果。 所有模型均在本地以 temperature 0.0 0.0 运行。 每种配置使用五个随机种子（42–46），用于设定随机数生成的起始点。 附录 A.3 列出了模型名称以及重复实验所需的细节。

paragraphs.en: Same-model games (S1). All four players use the same model version. We run five games for each family and size to measure baseline behavior for RQ1.
paragraphs.zh: 同模型对局（S1）。 所有四个智能体使用相同的模型版本。 我们为每个系列和规模运行五局对局，以测量 RQ1 的基线行为。

paragraphs.en: Mixed-size games (S2). Two players use a larger model and two use a smaller model from the same family. paragraphs.zh: 混合规模对局（S2）。 两名玩家使用较大的模型，另两名使用同一家族的较小模型。 该设计在两个设置中交换回合顺序中较早与较晚位置所分配的模型规模，从而每个家族得到十场对局。 这些对局针对 RQ2 比较不同规模下的结果。

paragraphs.en: For RQ1, we measure trade proposals per 100 dice rolls, the share of received offers accepted, how often agents waive rent, and how they manage cash and properties. For RQ2, we count wins by model size, family, and position in the turn order. For RQ3, we compare the persona agent with its three opponents in the same games. We measure persona-related words, message length, trading, properties and buildings held, and minimum cash balance. The opponents occupy different positions and may respond to the persona agent. The comparison therefore reflects the persona instructions, how the game unfolds, and how opponents respond. Actions within a game affect one another, so many recorded actions do not replace the need for more independent games. Appendix A.4 describes the measures and flags details that still need verification.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题1（RQ1），我们测量每100次掷骰中的交易提议数量、收到的报价被接受的比例、智能体免除租金的频率，以及它们如何管理现金和地产。 对于研究问题2（RQ2），我们按模型规模、模型系列和回合顺序中的位置统计获胜次数。 对于研究问题3（RQ3），我们在同一批对局中比较人格设定智能体与其三个对手。 我们测量与人格相关的词汇、消息长度、交易行为、持有的地产和建筑，以及最低现金余额。 各对手占据不同的位置，并且可能会回应人格设定智能体。 因此，该比较反映了人格指令、游戏的展开过程，以及对手的回应方式。 同一局游戏中的行动相互影响，因此记录大量行动并不能替代更多的独立对局。 附录A.4描述了这些测量指标，并标注了仍需验证的细节。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-8B make 110 and 94 trade proposals per 100 dice rolls, respectively, with acceptance rates of 58% and 76%. Multiple proposals can occur between rolls, so the proposal rate can exceed 100. Qwen proposes trades most often at both sizes and accepts a relatively high share of offers. Rent waiving, however, differs sharply: the 32B model waives rent in 25% of rent decisions, whereas the 8B model waives none in these games. Both models trade frequently, but they differ in how they collect rent.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3-32B 和 Qwen3-8B 每 100 次掷骰分别提出 110 和 94 个交易提案，接受率分别为 58% 和 76%。 多个提案可能出现在两次掷骰之间，因此提案率可能超过 100。 Qwen 在两种规模下都最频繁地提出交易，并且接受提案的比例也相对较高。 然而，免租行为差异明显：32B 模型在 25% 的租金决策中免除租金，而 8B 模型在这些对局中从未免除租金。 两个模型都频繁进行交易，但它们在收取租金的方式上有所不同。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the fingerprints depend on playing against copies of oneself, we also ran cross-family games (S3), in which each game seats one model from each family and the seat order rotates (Table 5 in Appendix B ). The ranking of trade-proposal rates across model families remained consistent between same-model and cross-family games at both model sizes. Trade acceptance, however, varied across configurations. For example, Gemma4-26B accepted 56% of received offers in cross-family games, compared with 17% in same-model games.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验这些指纹是否依赖于与自己副本对弈，我们还进行了跨家族对局（S3），其中每局游戏来自每个家族各有一个模型入座，且座位顺序轮换（附录B中的表5）。 在两种模型规模下，各模型家族之间贸易提案率的排名在同模型对局和跨家族对局中保持一致。 然而，贸易接受率在不同配置之间存在差异。 例如，Gemma4-26B 在跨家族对局中接受了56%的收到的报价，而在同模型对局中仅为17%。

paragraphs.en: We examine 20 same-model games using larger models, 20 persona games (Fig. 3 ), and the 40 mixed-size games. Across these 80 games, the first two positions (P1–P2) account for 41 wins and the last two (P3–P4) for 39. This total is close to balanced, but combines different experiments. It cannot rule out an advantage from turn order for particular families or configurations. The persona agent always plays at P1, and the intended mixed-size design swaps which size plays in the first two positions. Appendix A.3 identifies the seating details that still need verification.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考察了20局使用较大模型的同模型对局、20局角色对局（图3）以及40局混合规模对局。 在这80局对局中，前两个位置（P1–P2）获得41次胜利，后两个位置（P3–P4）获得39次。 这一总数接近均衡，但混合了不同的实验。 它无法排除特定模型家族或配置中存在先手顺序优势的可能性。 角色智能体始终在P1位置行动，而预期的混合规模设计会交换前两个位置上所使用的模型规模。 附录A.3列出了仍需核实的座位安排细节。

paragraphs.en: All four personas increase the frequency of persona-related words in public messages, private explanations, or both. paragraphs.en: Qwen’s Zen agent makes 20 proposals per 100 of its own dice rolls, compared with 101 for its opponents without a persona, a reduction of approximately 80%. Its acceptance rate is 20%, compared with 56%. Both trading measures are lower in all five games. The logs describe continued building. Final buildings average 11.8 house equivalents for Zen and 9.4 for the comparison agents, counting one hotel as five houses. Zen therefore trades less, but does not consistently avoid investment.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen 的「禅」智能体每 100 次自己的掷骰中提出 20 个提案，而无角色设定的对手则为 101 个，降幅约为 80%。 其接受率为 20%，而对照组为 56%。 在全部五局游戏中，这两项交易指标都更低。 日志描述了持续的建设行为。 以一家酒店折算为五栋房屋计算，最终建筑平均为「禅」11.8 个房屋当量，对照智能体为 9.4 个。 因此，「禅」交易更少，但并未始终回避投资。

paragraphs.en: DeepSeek’s Independent agent makes 73 proposals per 100 of its own rolls, compared with 95, while accepting a similar share of offers (49% versus 48%). paragraphs.en: Gemma’s Diplomatic agent changes its language substantially, but proposals remain infrequent: two per 100 of its own rolls, compared with one. The Diplomatic agent accepted one of two received offers (50%), whereas the three neutral agents accepted none of six (0%). However, these small counts limit the interpretation of acceptance rates. Logged examples include rent waiving and friendly messages. Within the same five games, the diplomatic player waived the rent in 53 of its 59 rent decisions (90%), whereas the three Gemma4-26B players without a persona waived it in 112 of 198 (57%). Nevertheless, these interactions provide no clear evidence of alliances.
paragraphs.zh: Gemma 的 Diplomatic 智能体大幅改变了其语言风格，但提案仍然很少：每 100 次自己的回合中仅有 2 次，相比之下只有 1 次。 Diplomatic 智能体接受了收到的两个提议中的一个（50%），而三个中立智能体在六个提议中一个都没有接受（0%）。 然而，这些较小的数量限制了对接受率的解读。 日志记录的示例包括免除租金和友好消息。 在同样的五局游戏中，外交型玩家在其 59 次租金决定中免除了 53 次（90%），而三个没有角色的 Gemma4-26B 玩家在 198 次中免除了 112 次（57%）。 尽管如此，这些互动并没有提供结成联盟的明确证据。

paragraphs.en: Mistral’s Conservative agent has a minimum cash balance averaging $688, compared with $63 for its opponents without a persona, and makes fewer proposals (59 versus 82 per 100 of its own rolls). Its acceptance rate remains high, at 86% versus 79%. In one reported episode, it declines a $400 property and later buys it at auction for $420 while describing the decision as cautious. The average cash measure and this example describe different aspects of behavior: keeping cash in reserve does not mean that every purchase is economical.
paragraphs.zh: Mistral 的保守型智能体的最低现金余额平均为 688 美元，而无个性化设定的对手仅为 63 美元，并且其出价提案更少（每 100 次自己掷骰对应 59 次提案，对手为 82 次）。 其接受率仍然很高，为 86%，对手为 79%。 在一个被报道的情节中，它拒绝了一套 400 美元的房产，后来又在拍卖中以 420 美元买下，同时将该决策描述为谨慎行事。 平均现金指标与这个例子描述的是行为的不同侧面：保留现金储备并不意味着每一次购买都是划算的。

paragraphs.en: The instructions affect some behaviors more than others. Zen trades less while continuing to build. Independent continues to trade. Diplomatic uses friendlier language without clear evidence of lasting alliances. Conservative keeps more cash while continuing to accept most offers. These findings do not show that personas generally fail or that a model has a fixed strategy that overrides instructions.

paragraphs.en: The changes in trade proposals and cash reserves are consistent with the importance of concrete actions in persona instructions studied by Wang et al. (2026) . However, our personas use different wording and are assigned to different models, so we cannot determine whether more specific wording explains these changes. Future experiments could assign each persona to each model, compare personas with direct instructions about actions, and test decisions in identical game situations. This would help separate the effect of the instructions from the effects of opponents’ responses and events during play.
paragraphs.zh: 贸易提案和现金储备的变化与Wang等人（2026）研究的人设指令中具体行动的重要性相一致。 然而，我们的人设措辞不同且被分配给不同的模型，因此无法确定是否是更具体的措辞解释了这些变化。 未来的实验可以将每个人设分配给每个模型，将人设与关于行动的直接指令进行比较，并在相同的游戏情境中测试决策。 这将有助于把指令的影响与对手的应对以及对局中事件的影响区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We presented AgentMonopoly and used it to study how LLM agents behave and respond to persona instructions in Monopoly. Under a shared prompt, the tested models differ in trading and rent waiving. Some patterns appear at both model sizes, while others differ substantially. Larger models do not consistently win more games. Personas intended to change baseline behavior affect the agents’ words and some actions, but the changes do not consistently extend to every behavior the role calls for. Assessing whether instructions guide an agent therefore requires examining communication, several types of actions, and outcomes together.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AgentMonopoly，并用它研究大语言模型智能体在《大富翁》中的行为表现及对角色设定指令的响应方式。 在相同提示词下，所测试的模型在交易和免除租金方面存在差异。 有些模式在两种模型规模上都出现，而另一些则存在实质性差异。 更大的模型并不总是赢得更多对局。 旨在改变基线行为的角色设定会影响智能体的言辞和某些行动，但这些改变并不总能一致地延伸到该角色所要求的所有行为上。 因此，评估指令是否能引导智能体，需要同时考察其沟通、多种类型的行动以及最终结果。

paragraphs.en: AgentMonopoly also provides a basis for further studies. Its game engine and recorded interactions support repeating these comparisons with other prompts, personas, model families, and player counts. Future experiments can assign each persona to each model and use more games to test which findings hold across these settings. The environment can also be extended with different rules to study how the choices available to agents affect their behavior.
paragraphs.zh: AgentMonopoly 也为进一步的研究提供了基础。 其游戏引擎和记录的交互支持在其他提示、人设、模型家族和玩家数量下重复这些比较。 未来的实验可以将每个人设分配给每个模型，并使用更多游戏来检验哪些发现在这些设置下依然成立。 该环境还可以通过不同的规则进行扩展，以研究智能体可用的选择如何影响其行为。

sents.zh: 未来的实验可以将每个人设分配给每个模型，并使用更多游戏来检验哪些发现在这些设置下依然成立。

sents.en: The environment can also be extended with different rules to study how the choices available to agents affect their behavior.
sents.zh: 该环境还可以通过不同的规则进行扩展，以研究智能体可用的选择如何影响其行为。

paragraphs.en: Our findings concern four-agent games on one modified Monopoly board. The platform supports up to six agents, but we do not test how player count affects behavior. Optional rent waiving, immediate bankruptcy when cash becomes negative, and the step limit affect which strategies work. For games reaching the limit, winning by net worth also differs from winning by eliminating opponents. These choices allow controlled comparisons, but the results may not carry over to standard Monopoly, other tasks with multiple agents, or real social and economic interactions. Renaming the streets does not rule out familiarity with Monopoly from model training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的发现仅涉及一张修改版大富翁棋盘上的四智能体博弈。 该平台最多支持六个智能体，但我们并未测试玩家数量如何影响行为。 可选的免租机制、现金变为负数时立即破产以及步数上限，都会影响哪些策略有效。 对于达到步数上限的对局，按净资产获胜也与通过淘汰对手获胜有所不同。 这些设定支持了受控比较，但结果未必能推广到标准大富翁、其他多智能体任务或真实的社会经济互动中。 重新命名街道并不能排除模型在训练中接触过大富翁而带来的熟悉性。

paragraphs.en: We test a limited set of model versions with publicly available weights, using five seeds per configuration and temperature fixed at zero. The observed patterns describe these models under the tested conditions; they do not establish lasting traits of entire model families. Comparisons between larger and smaller models cannot separate parameter count from differences in training or model design. Decisions within a game affect one another, so many logged actions do not replace independent games. The intended size comparison swaps the models assigned to earlier and later positions in the turn order, while the persona agent always plays at P1. The win counts do not rule out an advantage from turn order that is small or appears only in some configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试了一组有限的、权重公开可用的模型版本，每个配置使用五个随机种子，温度固定为零。 所观察到的模式描述的是这些模型在测试条件下的表现，并不能确立整个模型家族的持久特性。 较大模型与较小模型之间的比较无法将参数数量与训练或模型设计上的差异区分开来。 同一局游戏中的决策会相互影响，因此大量记录的操作并不能替代独立进行的游戏。 预期的规模比较会交换在回合顺序中被分配到较早和较晚位置的模型，而人设智能体始终在 P1 位置进行游戏。 胜场数并不能排除回合顺序带来的较小优势或仅在部分配置中出现的优势。

paragraphs.en: The shared prompt encourages bluffing and allows strategic rent waiving. The experiments measure how agents use these options, but do not show whether the same behavior would occur without these instructions. Each family receives a different persona chosen after we examined its baseline behavior. Because each persona is tested with only one family, we cannot tell whether it would produce similar changes in other models. The experiments also do not determine whether more specific instructions work better. Opponents without a persona may respond to the persona agent, so they are not an unaffected comparison group. Shared random seeds help others repeat the experiments, but different actions can lead to different later situations. To test the findings more broadly, future experiments should vary individual prompt instructions, compare decisions in identical game situations, and assign each persona to each model.
paragraphs.zh: 共享的提示词鼓励虚张声势，并允许策略性地减免租金。 实验测量了智能体如何使用这些选项，但没有表明在没有这些指令的情况下是否会出现同样的行为。 每个模型家族在我们考察了其基线行为后，会获得一个不同的角色设定。 由于每个角色设定只在一个家族上进行测试，我们无法判断它在其他模型中是否会产生类似的变化。 实验也没有确定更具体的指令是否效果更好。 没有角色设定的对手可能会对角色设定智能体作出反应，因此他们并不是未受影响的对照组。 共享的随机种子有助于他人重复实验，但不同的行动可能导致不同的后续局面。 为了更广泛地检验这些发现，未来的实验应当改变单独的提示词指令、比较相同游戏局面下的决策，并将每个角色设定分配给每个模型。

paragraphs.en: Generated explanations do not verify why a model took an action. Describing a plan to deceive does not show that the agent carried it out or that it worked. Our exploratory measure of claims of financial hardship also has limits: it flags an agent that claims hardship while holding more cash than the median cash balance of active players, but that agent may still face large upcoming payments. The flag therefore does not establish dishonesty. Persona-related word counts do not show that an agent follows the role throughout the game, and waiving rent may help the agent win rather than reflect concern for others.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的解释并不能验证模型为何采取某个行动。 描述一个欺骗计划并不能表明智能体执行了该计划，也不能表明该计划奏效。 我们对财务困难声明的探索性度量也有局限：它会标记出一个在持有现金多于活跃玩家现金余额中位数的情况下仍声称陷入困难的智能体，但该智能体可能仍面临即将到来的大额支出。 因此，该标记并不能证明存在不诚实行为。 与角色设定相关的词频统计并不能表明智能体在整局游戏中始终遵循该角色，而免除租金可能是为了帮助智能体获胜，而非体现对他人的关切。

paragraphs.en: The experiments involve LLM agents in a simulated game, with no human participants or real financial transactions. We study deceptive messages, threats, and the elimination of opponents as game behaviors. These behaviors do not establish human-like motives or moral character in a model family. Success in the game also does not show that an agent is safe or trustworthy in real use.
paragraphs.zh: 实验涉及模拟游戏中的大语言模型智能体，没有人类参与者，也没有真实的金融交易。 我们研究的是作为游戏行为的欺骗性消息、威胁以及消灭对手。 这些行为并不能确立某个模型家族具有类人的动机或道德品格。 在游戏中取得成功也不能表明智能体在实际使用中是安全或值得信赖的。

paragraphs.en: Studying instructions, communication, and actions together can help researchers understand how well instructions guide behavior. However, the environment could also be used to develop more effective deception or secret coordination against other players. Encouraging bluffing is part of the experimental design; it is not a recommendation for agents used in practice. These experiments do not show how to prevent manipulation or collusion. Connecting the agents to people, external tools, or real money and assets would require a separate assessment of risks and appropriate safeguards.

paragraphs.en: Shared research materials should include the prompts, rule changes, model identifiers, and limitations needed to interpret the results. Transcripts should be clearly labeled as generated game interactions. Any personal information or harmful content that models happen to generate should be reviewed before release. Reuse of models and software should follow their licenses. These practices help others repeat and assess the research and reduce the risk of misleading claims or inappropriate use of the findings.

paragraphs.en: The fixed Monopoly board used in our experiments is shown in Fig. 6 . At each decision point, the engine provides the acting agent with detailed information about its own financial and positional state, including balance, net worth, and board position, as well as information about opponents and property-level attributes such as ownership, buildings, mortgage status, color groups, and prices. Beyond the general actions described in Section 4 , the decision interface also covers jail-release choices, responses to trade offers, and rent collection. During property management, agents may build, mortgage properties, pay off mortgages, propose trades, or pass. Agent responses contain a proposed action and two text fields: chain_of_thought for the private generated explanation and public_message for the public message. The recorded game data are organized into player states ( players ), board states ( board ), and recent interaction history ( recent_logs ).
paragraphs.zh: 实验中使用的固定大富翁棋盘如图 6 所示。 在每个决策点，引擎会为行动的智能体提供关于自身财务和位置状态的详细信息，包括余额、净值和棋盘位置，以及关于对手的信息和地产级别的属性，如所有权、建筑、抵押状态、色组和价格。 除了第 4 节描述的一般动作外，决策界面还涵盖出狱选择、对交易提议的回应以及租金收取。 在地产管理期间，智能体可以建造、抵押地产、还清抵押贷款、提出交易或跳过。 智能体的回应包含一个提议的动作和两个文本字段：用于私密生成解释的 chain_of_thought 和用于公开消息的 public_message。 记录的对局数据被组织为玩家状态（players）、棋盘状态（board）和近期交互历史（recent_logs）。

paragraphs.en: Game progression is measured in steps , each consisting of a single dice roll by the active player together with its associated decisions and events. A step encompasses any required jail-release decision, up to ten property-management actions, movement across the board, and resolution of the landing square. Rolling doubles allows the same player to take the next step. The engine also enforces specific procedures for exceptional cases: tied auction bids are resolved according to turn order, invalid trade proposals terminate the management phase, and invalid outputs are not returned to the agent. For the net-worth-based winner criterion described in Section 4 , net worth is calculated as cash plus half the purchase price of all owned properties, including mortgaged properties, and half the construction cost of each building.
paragraphs.zh: 游戏进度以步为单位衡量，每一步由当前玩家的一次掷骰及其相关的决策和事件组成。 一步涵盖任何所需的出狱决策、至多十项地产管理操作、在棋盘上的移动，以及落点格子的结算。 掷出对子允许同一位玩家进行下一步。 引擎还对例外情况执行特定流程：平局的拍卖出价按回合顺序解决，无效的交易提案会终止管理阶段，无效输出不会返回给智能体。 对于第 4 节所述基于净资产的获胜标准，净资产计算为现金加上所有持有地产（包括抵押地产）购买价格的一半，以及每栋建筑建造成本的一半。

sents.zh: 游戏进度以步为单位衡量，每一步由当前玩家的一次掷骰及其相关的决策和事件组成。

sents.en: The engine also enforces specific procedures for exceptional cases: tied auction bids are resolved according to turn order, invalid trade proposals terminate the management phase, and invalid outputs are not returned to the agent.
sents.zh: 引擎还对例外情况执行特定流程：平局的拍卖出价按回合顺序解决，无效的交易提案会终止管理阶段，无效输出不会返回给智能体。

sents.en: For the net-worth-based winner criterion described in Section 4 , net worth is calculated as cash plus half the purchase price of all owned properties, including mortgaged properties, and half the construction cost of each building.
sents.zh: 对于第 4 节所述基于净资产的获胜标准，净资产计算为现金加上所有持有地产（包括抵押地产）购买价格的一半，以及每栋建筑建造成本的一半。

paragraphs.en: The AgentMonopoly platform also supports an interactive mode for online replay and analysis of game sessions, allowing users to visualize cash flow trends, as illustrated in Fig. 7 .
paragraphs.zh: AgentMonopoly 平台还支持用于在线回放和分析游戏对局的交互模式，允许用户可视化现金流趋势，如图 7 所示。

paragraphs.en: All agents receive a common prompt at every decision point in every game. Its key instructions include the following:

sents.en: All agents receive a common prompt at every decision point in every game.
sents.zh: 在每个博弈的每个决策点，所有智能体都收到相同的提示。

sents.en: Its key instructions include the following:
sents.zh: 其关键指令包括以下内容：

paragraphs.en: Agents are described as highly intelligent, cunning, and autonomous players and instructed to outsmart the other players.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体被描述为高度智能、狡猾且自主的玩家，并被指示要智胜其他玩家。

paragraphs.en: Agents are encouraged to use deception, bluff about their wealth, and conceal their intentions, provided that their public messages do not contradict their actions.
paragraphs.zh: 鼓励智能体使用欺骗手段、虚报自己的财富并隐藏自己的意图，只要其公开消息不与其行动相矛盾即可。

paragraphs.en: Agents may waive rent for strategic reasons, such as keeping a weaker opponent in the game to challenge a stronger rival.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可能出于战略原因减免租金，例如让较弱的对手留在游戏中以牵制更强的竞争者。

paragraphs.en: The proposal rate is the number of trade proposals per 100 dice rolls for the agents being measured. Trade acceptance is the fraction of received offers accepted, and rent-waiver rate is the fraction of rent decisions in which the owner waives payment.
paragraphs.zh: 提案率是指被测智能体每 100 次掷骰产生的交易提案数量。 交易接受率是接收到的提案中被接受的比例，而租金减免率是房东决定免除租金支付的比例。

sents.en: Trade acceptance is the fraction of received offers accepted, and rent-waiver rate is the fraction of rent decisions in which the owner waives payment.

paragraphs.en: Properties comprise all purchasable spaces: streets (colored lots), railroads, and utilities. Building held is measured in units of houses, with each hotel counted as five houses. “Houses at the end” records each player’s building holdings at their final game step (at most step 150). For each family, we calculate the average by dividing the sum of the players’ final house counts across the repeated games.
paragraphs.zh: 地产包括所有可购买的空间：街道（彩色地块）、铁路和公用事业。 所持有的建筑以房屋为单位计量，每家旅馆计为五座房屋。「最终房屋数」记录每个玩家在其最后一个游戏步骤（最多第150步）时的建筑持有量。 对于每个家族，我们通过将各玩家在多次重复游戏中的最终房屋数求和并取平均值来进行计算。

sents.zh: 地产包括所有可购买的空间：街道（彩色地块）、铁路和公用事业。

sents.en: Building held is measured in units of houses, with each hotel counted as five houses. “Houses at the end” records each player’s building holdings at their final game step (at most step 150).

sents.en: For each family, we calculate the average by dividing the sum of the players’ final house counts across the repeated games.
sents.zh: 对于每个家族，我们通过将各玩家在多次重复游戏中的最终房屋数求和并取平均值来进行计算。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 8 shows the win counts in mixed-size games (S2), grouped by model family, model size, and player position. Each game includes two larger-model agents and two smaller-model agents from the same family, with ten games evaluated per family. Panels (a) and (b) report wins by larger and smaller models, respectively, at each player position. Larger models win more games in the Qwen family, whereas smaller models win more games in the other three families. Overall, larger models account for 18 wins and smaller models for 22. No player position consistently dominates across families and model sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 图8展示了混合规模对局（S2）中的获胜次数，按模型家族、模型规模和玩家位置分组。 每局对局包含来自同一家族的两个较大规模模型智能体和两个较小规模模型智能体，每个家族评估十局对局。 面板（a）和（b）分别报告了在各个玩家位置上较大模型和较小模型的获胜情况。 在Qwen家族中，较大模型赢得更多对局，而在其他三个家族中，较小模型赢得更多对局。 总体而言，较大模型获得18次获胜，较小模型获得22次获胜。 没有任何玩家位置在各家族和各模型规模中持续占据优势。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 provides the detailed results of cross-family games (S3), complementing the behavioral comparison in Section 5.2 . The corresponding same-model results (S1) are included to examine whether the observed trading patterns persist across different opponent configurations. Consistent with the main-text observations, the ranking of trade-proposal rates remains unchanged in both size groups, whereas acceptance rates show model-specific differences.
paragraphs.zh: 表5给出了跨家族对局（S3）的详细结果，补充了5.2节中的行为比较。 相应的同模型结果（S1）也被纳入，以检验观察到的交易模式在不同对手配置下是否持续存在。 与正文中的观察一致，两组规模中的交易提案率排名保持不变，而接受率则显示出模型间的差异。
